property_summary: For every admissible Collect(_am) call, C must leave the caller's Acc.balance unchanged when the current timestamp is not strictly greater than the caller's unlockTime; the buggy version violates this by allowing a withdrawal when block.timestamp == acc.unlockTime.
change_summary: Change the Collect guard from block.timestamp > acc.unlockTime to block.timestamp >= acc.unlockTime, allowing collection exactly at unlock time.
